parameters.content:
No model is used. Run n8n/scripts/firefly-subscriptions-setup.sh to import this workflow and its credentials.

List Firefly bills: Header Auth credential "Hermes digest – Firefly III token" (hermes-digests-setup.sh).

CalDAV requests: Basic Auth credential "Nextcloud CalDAV – Payments" (Nextcloud user plus app password).

The calendar URL is fixed in the "Payments calendar" node; its user must match the credential. n8n's HTTP Request node sends no body with PROPFIND/REPORT, so there is no CalDAV discovery. Each event stores the amount, next date, and Firefly id; the PUT to a fixed per-bill URL is an upsert.
